lines.zh: 我的蹄子碾过绯红菌岩。
lines.en: My hooves grind over crimson fungus rock.
Four hooves strike the ground, body stiff.

lines.zh: 它走着，眼睛却看向别处
lines.en: It walks while its eyes look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 疣猪兽的獠牙，也在发白。
lines.en: Even my hoglin tusks have gone pale.

lines.zh: 我嗅着洞穴的风，獠牙在磨。
lines.en: I sniff the cave wind, grinding my tusks.

lines.zh: 我的背脊一耸，抖落几只蝇。
lines.en: My spine jerks, shaking off a few flies.

lines.zh: 我的眼白翻上来，又落下去。
lines.en: My eyes roll up white, then drop back.
Suddenly locking eyes on the player

lines.zh: 注意玩家的每一个动作
我隔着獠牙看你，鼻息很重。
lines.en: I watch you past my tusks, breath heavy.
Ow~ That hurts to the bone.

lines.zh: 嘶~ 疼到我喘不过气。
嘶~ 疼到我要倒下了。
lines.en: Ow~ It hurts so much that I’m about to fall.
Ow~ That hurts so much that I’m shaking.

lines.zh: 它用锐利的獠牙威胁你
lines.en: It threatens you with sharp fangs

lines.zh: 苍白之魂使它的声音嘶哑
lines.en: Pale soul gives it a raspy voice

lines.zh: 它的皮肤因附身而泛白
lines.en: Its skin is pale from possession

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着贪婪的光芒

lines.en: It tries to touch you with its horn

lines.zh: 它贪婪地盯着你手中的食物
lines.en: It greedily stares at your food

lines.zh: 它在阴暗的洞穴中觅食
它对鲜血有着无法抑制的渴望
lines.en: It has an insatiable craving for blood

lines.zh: 它撞向你，发出金属般的声音
lines.en: It collides with you, making a metallic sound

lines.zh: 它的身体碰撞发出尖锐的响声
lines.en: Its body collision makes a sharp sound

lines.zh: 你感觉它的力量如石块般沉重
lines.en: You feel its weight like a stone

lines.zh: 它的坚硬皮肤敲击出回声
lines.en: Its hard skin echoes with a bang

lines.zh: 它粗重的呼吸声震耳欲聋
你被它巨大的体型撞倒
lines.en: You are knocked down by its large size

lines.zh: 它的碰撞仿佛能震裂岩石
它在战斗中与你猛烈碰撞
lines.en: It collides with you fiercely in battle

lines.zh: 它的身体撞击让你难以喘息
lines.en: Its body collision leaves you breathless

lines.zh: 它以非人类的力量冲击你
lines.en: It冲击 you with non-human strength

lines.zh: 它用獠牙尝试触碰伴侣
lines.en: It tries to touch its mate with its fangs

lines.zh: 苍白之魂影响它的交配行为
lines.en: Pale soul affects its mating behavior

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中燃烧着欲望

lines.en: It tries to lure its partner with its horn

lines.zh: 它在月光下显得更加邪恶
lines.en: It appears more evil in moonlight

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在月光下发出苍白的光
lines.en: Its skin glows pale in moonlight

lines.zh: 它试图用獠牙攻击对方
lines.en: It attempts to attack its partner with its fangs

lines.zh: 它的动作显得更加激烈
它的叫声中充满了欲望
lines.en: Its call is filled with desire

lines.zh: 这块肉，我先用獠牙戳住。
lines.en: I pin this meat down with my tusks first.

lines.zh: 我低下头，獠牙去拱你的腿。
lines.en: I lower my head and hook a tusk at your leg.

lines.zh: 我叼起腐肉，獠牙上还挂着筋。
lines.en: I pick up rotten flesh, sinew still hanging from my tusks.
Rummm, I’m going to eat you!
The scent of the pale demon!

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，我的肚子里有你！
lines.en: Rummm, I have you in my belly!
This body belongs to me now.
Prey acquired, I’m going to eat you!

lines.zh: 你的气味从菌岩后面飘过来。
lines.en: Your scent drifts from behind the fungus rock.
Sssss, I’m going to tear you apart!
Pain of the pale soul, my strength!
My tusks lower, aimed at you.
The anger of the pale demon!
I am the weapon of the pale demon!
Those tusks are not its own.
Possessed, it no longer fears fire.
Do you mean to save me, or to run?

lines.zh: 苍白的手按着我的獠牙。
lines.en: A pale hand is pressing on my tusks.
Pain of the pale soul, let me devour!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会吃掉你！
lines.en: You can’t escape, I’ll eat you!

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，我的牙齿要吃你！
lines.en: Rummm, my teeth are for you!
I’m going to eat all your flesh!
The power of the pale soul!

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，我要吃了你！
lines.en: You are my prey, I’m going to eat you!
It lowers its head, horns aimed at you.

lines.zh: 苍白的手从它背后伸出
lines.en: A pale hand reaches out from behind it.
Two wills, and both want you.
Roars and bites with sharp teeth!
A tusk flicks you into the air.
It charges like a block of stone.
Its claws gouge furrows in the stone wall.

lines.zh: 它不知道自己咬得多狠
lines.en: It does not know how hard it bites.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，猪变成了别的东西
lines.en: Deep in the caves, the hog became something else.

lines.zh: 苍白恶魔挑中了这具身体
lines.en: The pale demon chose this body.
